title: Leadership Power Circle — S.M.A.R.T. Performance Podcast
author: Walter Dusseldorp, FACHE, MBA, LSSBB
description: The course ends. Your growth doesn't. Welcome to the Leadership Power Circle — the podcast where leaders keep doing the daily reps, built on the S.M.A.R.T. Performance framework from Walter Dusseldorp (FACHE, MBA), The Dutch Mentor. Real strategies, honest conversations, and small actions that compound into lasting leadership. Because behavior is the key, and consistency is the magic. Join the Circle: https://dutchguide.gumroad.com/l/leadership-power-circle #Leadership #SmartPerformance
